description: Cyclone Summaries 1900-2015 is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by CSIRO Marlin Data Catalogue. This dataset is a summary of global cyclone frequency. Data on the tracks of cyclones since 1900 was sourced from the International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS). Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher CSIRO Marlin Data Catalogue. Its tags are Atmosphere | Atmospheric Phenomena | Cyclones, Atmosphere | Atmospheric Phenomena | Storms. It offers 4 resource(s) in html, png, wms. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
